about: Which process holding a machine's disk runs the machine, judged by its executable path (proc_pidpath). The CLI's rule is VPhoneProcessHolder.kind(executablePath:) in VPhoneCoreKit; Launchpad, which does not link VPhoneCoreKit, has its own copy in VPhoneLaunchpadDiskHolder.runsMachine. VPhoneCoreKitTests (LaunchLayoutTests) and VPhoneLaunchpad/Tests/TemplatesTests.sh both run every case here against their copy, so a change to one copy fails the other's test until both agree. Kind is virtualMachine, virtualizationService or other; Launchpad counts the first two as running the machine. A null path is a process that is gone or cannot be inspected.
